working_tree: clean; src/ byte-identical to HEAD (git status --porcelain empty)

correction.strategy: reuses the SAME already-loaded generation model instance; no second model is loaded

verification.dtype: float16 on cuda, float32 on cpu
verification.device_default: cuda (hard-fails if CUDA absent; no silent CPU fallback)

_notes.fuzzy_method: value is correct behaviorally but comes from the match_evidence() function default, NOT from config - pipeline.py never reads evidence_matching.fuzzy_method (see DISCREPANCY D1)
_notes.correction.max_attempts: declared in config but never read by src/ - single attempt is hardcoded (D4)
_notes.claim_parsing.citation_regex: declared in config but never read; the config copy is stale vs the live CITATION_REGEX (D2)

citation_regexes.CITATION_REGEX: claim_parser.py:76-86 - keyword + number-list + optional Part qualifier + (in|of) + act, IGNORECASE
citation_regexes.BARE_CITATION_REGEX: claim_parser.py:99-101 - keyword + number-list, no act clause
citation_regexes.number_list: claim_parser.py:54,59-62 - comma / and / & separated; one Claim per provision number
citation_regexes.trailing_acronym: claim_parser.py:362,373-376 - IPC / CrPC / CPC with no in/of connector

art_abbreviation_handling.pattern: Arts?\.  (trailing period REQUIRED so bare 'Art'/'Arts' never matches)
art_abbreviation_handling.no_space_tolerated: \s* after keyword, because 'Art.227' occurs in real output

acronym_normalization.symmetric: the same function normalizes the evidence corpus act names (data_loader.py:59)

truncation_handling.act_name_over_capture: _trim_act_name (claim_parser.py:260-308) - 4 independent candidate cut points, EARLIEST-WINS; returns (trimmed, consumed_length) so leftover text is re-scanned, not discarded
truncation_handling.spurious_subspan_act: _find_bare_act_mentions excludes spans already claimed by a full-form citation (claim_parser.py:555-575)
truncation_handling.nli_input_truncation: detected (never prevented) at verifier.py:195-196 as input_truncated; currently inert (~354/512 tokens worst case)

assertion_narrowing.assertion_text: _assign_assertion_texts (claim_parser.py:814) - 4 ordered conservative passes: semicolon (724), ' while ' (687), citation-keyword-boundary (750), parenthetical gloss (778); always a contiguous VERBATIM substring; falls back to full claim_text
assertion_narrowing.assertion_spans: _assign_respectively_spans (claim_parser.py:970) - [bare_number_span, description_item] for the 'respectively' pattern; fails closed on any ambiguity; defaults to [assertion_text]

negation_detection.effect: sets negation_contradiction_caveat; excludes the claim from auto-correction ONLY; verdict/confidence/sub_reason untouched

act_inheritance.step1: same (provision_type, provision_number) resolved to exactly ONE distinct act elsewhere in the field
act_inheritance.step2: exactly ONE distinct act resolved anywhere in the field
act_inheritance.otherwise: left unresolved (act_norm=''), which can never match a corpus act -> NO_EVIDENCE. Never invented.

retrieval.legal_identity_gate: provision_type AND provision_number must match EXACTLY in every path; only the act NAME is ever fuzzed

year_conflict_veto.rule: if BOTH sides name an explicit year and the year sets are disjoint, the pair can never fuzzy-match
year_conflict_veto.reason: act_significant_words() tokenizes with [a-z']+ and drops digits, so two same-named Acts differing only by year would cross-match at overlap 1.0

jaccard.formula: len(a & b) / len(a | b) over act_significant_words() token sets, with a digit-insensitive exact-set short-circuit to 1.0

no_evidence_taxonomy.note: diagnostic/ablation instrumentation only; never read by any decision

evidence_pool.merge_rule: v1 records REPLACE same-keyed v0 records (data_loader.py:115); 59 + 78 - 1 overlap = 136
evidence_pool.method: counted by parsing every non-blank line of each JSONL as JSON, then executing the real loader with the shipped config

retrieval_signals.reason: all four pipeline.py match_evidence() call sites (181, 678, 878, 1256) pass only 4 positional args, so fuzzy_method falls back to its function default 'jaccard' and fuzzy_act_index stays None; 'fuzzy_method' never appears in pipeline.py
retrieval_signals.safety_invariant: can only re-score act-name similarity; exact provision identity + year veto are applied BEFORE any score is consulted, so similarity can never override citation identity (retrieval_signals.py:4-12)

verifier.label_order_source: read from model.config.id2label at load time; raises on an unexpected label rather than guessing (verifier.py:162-173)
verifier.premise_fallback: returns bare evidence_text if provision_type, provision_number or act is missing (verifier.py:76-77)
verifier.premise_label_source: the MATCHED EVIDENCE RECORD's own identity (_evidence_provision), deliberately NOT the claim's citation_extracted (pipeline.py:55-71)
hypothesis_rules: assertion_span_primary_hypothesis (OFF): would build '{provision_type} {provision_number} {description}' from a 2-element assertion_spans via _assertion_spans_hypothesis (pipeline.py:308)
verifier.threshold_rule: argmax confidence < 0.70 -> verdict downgraded to NOT_ENOUGH_INFORMATION with sub_reason='low_confidence' (verifier.py:220-222)
verifier.truncation_detection: untruncated tokenization probe; input_truncated recorded but never alters the verdict (verifier.py:184-196)
verifier.disclaimer: NLI statistical confidence, not a legal-correctness determination.

correction.dormant_path: apply_selective_correction_assertion_aware (pipeline.py:1009) - fragment splice; gated off by correction.assertion_aware=false
correction.trigger_rule: _should_trigger_correction (pipeline.py:96): CONTRADICTED (any confidence) OR NOT_ENOUGH_INFORMATION with sub_reason=='low_confidence'; never NO_EVIDENCE; never a high-confidence genuine neutral
correction.target: first flagged claim only (pipeline.py:730); multi-claim correction is out of scope for this prototype (pipeline.py:17-22)
correction.model_reuse: SelectiveCorrector wraps the already-loaded generator; raises if not loaded (corrector.py:50-51)
correction.live_system_prompt: You are revising a single sentence in the "Statutory Grounding" section of an Indian court judgment summary. You will be given the full original paragraph, one flagged sentence that is unsupported or contradicted by the cited law, and (if available) the actual text of the relevant statute. Rewrite ONLY the flagged sentence so it is consistent with the statute text provided. Return the FULL paragraph with every other sentence copied verbatim/unchanged, and only the flagged sentence modified. Output only the paragraph, nothing else.
correction.evidence_block:
'Actual statute text:
{evidence_text}
' or 'No supporting statute text is available in the evidence corpus for this claim.
'

safety_gates.name: NO_EVIDENCE short-circuit
safety_gates.blocks: verifying any claim with no premise; NO_EVIDENCE is fixed regardless of mode

safety_gates.name: Negation carve-out
safety_gates.blocks: auto-correcting a CONTRADICTED verdict driven by grammatical negation; verdict itself untouched

safety_gates.name: Trigger policy
safety_gates.blocks: correcting a high-confidence genuine neutral NEI, or any NO_EVIDENCE claim

safety_gates.name: Scope violation (atomic_scope_check=assertion_spans)
safety_gates.blocks: any correction where an unflagged claim's required fragments do not ALL survive verbatim -> correction_scope_violation

safety_gates.name: Word-boundary fragment check
safety_gates.blocks: the '34' matching inside '134' class of silent sibling corruption that plain `in` containment missed

safety_gates.name: Unauthorized citation addition / injection
safety_gates.blocks: any citation identity in the corrected text with no baseline counterpart - a hallucinated new citation, or the flagged citation swapped for a different provision -> correction_unauthorized_addition

safety_gates.name: Ordinal-position integrity
safety_gates.blocks: a sibling reorder that would make an untouched sibling be re-verified as if it were the edit, shipping a fabricated ENTAILED confirmation -> correction_ordinal_ambiguous

safety_gates.name: Sibling regression
safety_gates.blocks: a correction that preserved each sibling's required fragment but changed the surrounding sentence enough that a sibling now genuinely re-verifies CONTRADICTED -> correction_sibling_regression

safety_gates.name: Re-verification acceptance
safety_gates.blocks: shipping any correction that does not re-verify ENTAILED; NEI/CONTRADICTED/unmatched all stay correction_failed

safety_gates.name: Structural-span preservation
safety_gates.blocks: a multi-element assertion_spans claim losing its structural span (e.g. the bare provision number) -> correction_structural_span_lost

safety_gates.name: Splice determinism
safety_gates.blocks: shipping text the pipeline did not construct unambiguously: empty fragment, span not occurring exactly once, or corrected claim text not occurring exactly once -> correction_splice_unavailable

safety_gates.name: Span representation validity
safety_gates.blocks: correcting when assertion_spans is missing or malformed -> correction_span_invalid

safety_gates.name: Premise-framing validation
safety_gates.blocks: a typo silently producing a bare-framing run mislabelled as a labeled ablation; raises naming the value

safety_gates.name: NLI label-order validation
safety_gates.blocks: guessing label indices for a differently-ordered or unexpected checkpoint; raises

safety_gates.name: No silent CPU fallback
safety_gates.blocks: a misconfigured GPU run silently becoming an impractically slow CPU run

safety_gates.name: Act never invented
safety_gates.blocks: guessing an Act for a bare citation; an act mentioned AFTER the citation is never used; unresolved -> NO_EVIDENCE

safety_gates.name: Respectively fail-closed
safety_gates.blocks: guessing a citation-to-description mapping on any ambiguity or count mismatch

safety_gates.name: Year-conflict veto
safety_gates.blocks: fuzzy-matching two legally distinct enactments differing only by year

safety_gates.name: Legal-identity gate
safety_gates.blocks: any fuzziness in provision type/number; only the act name is ever fuzzed

safety_gates.name: Truncation detection
safety_gates.blocks: nothing - instrumentation only; flags when a premise's trailing proviso could have been cut (currently inert, ~354/512 tokens)

reverification.replacement_lookup: ordinal position among same-citation-identity claims via _citation_identity (pipeline.py:586, 806-825)
reverification.rematch: match_evidence() on the re-extracted citation - the corrected sentence must independently re-earn its evidence (pipeline.py:878-883)
reverification.premise_framing: identical to the original verdict's framing (resolve_premise_framing at pipeline.py:906)

narrow_reverification_hypothesis.rule: if replacement.assertion_text != replacement.claim_text, verify the narrower verbatim assertion_text instead of the full sentence
narrow_reverification_hypothesis.rationale: on a bundled sentence the full sentence dilutes the hypothesis with sibling citations' content; measured real example 0.54 NEI on full sentence vs 0.999 ENTAILED on the narrow fragment, same evidence, same corrected text
narrow_reverification_hypothesis.never_widens: assertion_text is always a genuine substring of the model's own corrected output

reverification.acceptance: ENTAILED is the ONLY accepting label (pipeline.py:931-932)

final_assembly.mode_B: always original - verification is diagnostic and can never change the output (pipeline.py:5-8,1411)
final_assembly.mode_C: corrected text shipped ONLY when status=='corrected'; every other status ships the ORIGINAL with source naming the specific rejection reason
final_assembly.rejected_text_retained: in correction_summary.regenerated_text for inspection; never discarded

cases.usage_constraint: NyayaRAG's own `sections` free-text VALUES are never read as evidence - only the citation KEYS, and only for case selection (data_loader.py:9-14)
